what: [mandate_resolver defect / R-HOLDOUT on commission-free venues] scripts/ops/mandate_resolver.py::_holdout requires holdout_confirmation.cost_stack.fees > 0. Alpaca ETFs are commission-free: resolve_fee_bps_roundtrip('SPY') = 0.0, and the holdout harness writes fees 0.0 (RQ-20261023-be01-02 measurement.holdout_confirmation.cost_stack). So NO Alpaca leg can ever pass R-HOLDOUT, whatever its result. Fix (loosens a wrong check, no new gate): accept fees == the venue fee from resolve_fee_bps_roundtrip(symbol) when slippage > 0; keep fees > 0 for venues that charge one. Test with the be01-02 block.
